title: How Rebirth Works in Capy Kingdom: Idle Shooter
subtitle: When to reset, what you keep, and how to spend Golden Yuzu.
description: How rebirth works in Capy Kingdom: Idle Shooter. What resets, what you keep, how Golden Yuzu is earned and spent in the Yuzu Tree, and when to rebirth.
card: How rebirth works in Capy Kingdom: Idle Shooter, what Golden Yuzu does, what the Yuzu Tree gives, and how to tell when a reset is worth it.

faq.q: What is Golden Yuzu in Capy Kingdom: Idle Shooter?
faq.a: Golden Yuzu is the currency you earn from rebirth. It permanently raises your damage and is also spent in the Yuzu Tree on permanent perks. The more Yuzu you earn in a run, the stronger every future run becomes.

faq.q: Does spending Golden Yuzu lower my damage?
faq.a: No. The rebirth damage bonus is based on the Golden Yuzu you have earned in total, not the amount you still hold. You can spend Yuzu in the tree without weakening the bonus.

faq.q: Do I lose my weapons and pets when I rebirth?
faq.a: Your climb through the stages restarts, but the game remembers your best stage ever and fast-forwards you back toward it with a catch-up dash over stages whose bosses fall quickly. Read the Rebirth tab before confirming.
